lines.t: Ayo, it's wartime, no love for the snake Fake hearts crumble when the ground quake
Too long men slept, lost in they lust Now the king shied down, rise from the dust
Set your house in order, clean your yard
This walk ain't soft, this faith fit hard
She either help you rise or she pull you fall
Jezebel smile, but her kiss kill all
Put truth first, let his fire burn
Every false love, boy, you better discern
Gold in a furnace, soul gotta turn
Obey or be broken, that's the only term
Adam stood tall when he walked the line
Till he let her lay, then the curse was found
But Noah had a woman that held the door
Reign didn't shake what was built on the law
Abigail spoke peace, saved her king
Asked to face death, didn't fear no rain
A true queen embraces the mission's flame
When the world go dark, she protect the name
Loyalty read when the world come near
Only the faithful gon' stand and fear
She built a man from the dust and pain
She ride with the world garbed in her veins
Set your house in order, stand like steel
The serpent bite quick, his charm ain't real
But Jezebel laugh when she drain your flame
Cut her chains and renounce that name
Put God first, no other throne
Every weak tie, let it be thrown
When the thunder strike, truth alone
Only I who sure ain't on his own, they had bowed down, lost their sight
Sands and love flesh more than the fight
Solid men wise, but the women deceived
Split the kingdom for the love he conceived
Now these streets full of feminists built
Brothers walk blind, kissing jazz of the belt
They talk like kings, but they heart straight fraud
You can't lead a queen when you can't fear God
It's deeper than pride, it's the call to war
Quit chasin' peace, man, born to restore
She gotta follow the words you preach
If she don't submit, then cut that leech
Set your house in order, don't delay
Purify the temple, clear the decay
If she ain't for truth, she in the way
The most high gon' judge, he don't play
Lay your crown down, let his will reign
Repent in fire, purge every stain
It's the path of the real, no fame
Y'all who sure comin' back, call his name This ain't love songs, this a covenant talk
This ground red hot with a chosen walk Keep your sword sharp, don't lose your grip
The devil use beauty when he plantin' his trick
Stayin' firm, man, set your house in line Blood on the door when he passin' time
Let the world burn, we just refine Y'all sure ain't eternal design
